fun plan(pr: String) {
  val scope = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
  val changedFiles = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt")
  val diff = readDiff(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val docCandidates = findDocs(root = ".", patterns = listOf("README*", "docs/**", "*.md", "*.rst"))
  val cliCommand = readFile(path = "cli/command.py")
  val dscliDoc = readFile(path = "docs/source_zh_cn/deployment/dscli.md")
  val readmeZh = readFile(path = "README.md")
  val readmeEn = readFile(path = "README_EN.md")
  val quickStart = readFile(path = "docs/source_zh_cn/quick_start/quick_start.md")
  val analysis = analyze(scope = scope, changedFiles = changedFiles, diff = diff, taskContext = taskContext, docCandidates = docCandidates, cliCommand = cliCommand, dscliDoc = dscliDoc, readmeZh = readmeZh, readmeEn = readmeEn, quickStart = quickStart)
  val evidenceFile = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = analysis)
  val noopResult = safeoutputsNoop(message = "Docs-updated preflight complete; evidence written.")
}
